newsitem.title: UK: Merrill Lynch leads $1.1 bln asset-backed bond.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch leads $1.1 bln asset-backed bond.

text.p: World Omni 1007-A, an Automobile Lease Securitization Trust, has launched a four-tranche bond for a total of $1.107 billion, lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Monday.
Class A-1 notes total $250 million, have an average life of 1.48 years and will be priced to yield 27 to 29 basis points over the 5.875 percent October 1998 Treasury note.
Class A-2 notes total $290 million, have an average life of 2.12 years and will be priced to yield 28 to 30 b.p. over the 6.75 percent June 1999 Treasury note.
Class A-3 notes total $290 million, have an average life of 2.65 years and will be priced to yield 29 to 31 b.p. over the 7.75 percent December 1999 Treasury note.
Class A-4 notes total $277.3 million, have an average life of 3.01 years and will be priced to yield 30 to 32 b.p. over the 6.75 percent April 2000 Treasury note.
